title: Describe a Simple Meal

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前独立审核。

instructions: Prepare briefly, then record your own answer. Aim for 90–120 seconds; this is a suggested target, not a minimum. Use at least six lesson words. To pass review, your answer’s transcript must contain at least 100 words, and the required audio and review evidence must be available. The reference and its audio are short language examples, not full-length demonstrations; create your own answer.
prompt: Describe a simple meal you would prepare for other people. What ingredients would you choose, what would you do first and next, and how would you check your guests’ needs? Aim to speak for 90–120 seconds and use at least six lesson words.
reference: I would make a warm vegetable dish for three friends. Before I begin, I would ask if anyone has a food need I should know about. I would choose a potato, an onion, a carrot and some cooked beans. First, I would wash the vegetables and peel the potato. Then I would chop the onion and put a little oil in a pan. I would fry the onion, add the carrot and stir the mixture. I would boil the potato separately and mix it with the beans. Before serving, I would taste the dish and ask whether the flavor is suitable. I would keep the cheese separate and make sure there is enough bread for everyone.
